title: Duplicate charges
text: If the same order is charged more than once, the duplicate amount is refunded in full to the original payment method without requiring a return.

title: Failed but debited UPI payments
text: When a UPI payment fails but the customer's bank account is debited, the amount is auto-reversed by the bank within five working days; raise a refund only if it is not reversed by then.

title: Unauthorised transactions
text: Transactions the customer did not authorise are handled by the fraud team; the card or account is blocked first, and provisional credit is decided after investigation.

title: Goods not delivered
text: If the merchant confirms non-delivery or the courier marks the parcel lost, the customer receives a full refund after the delivery window has passed.

title: Subscription cancellations
text: Subscriptions cancelled within 48 hours of renewal are refunded for the unused period; later cancellations stop the next renewal only.

title: Partial refunds
text: Where only some items in an order are returned or missing, refund the value of those items plus proportional shipping.

title: Refund timelines
text: Refunds to UPI and wallets reach the customer within five working days; card refunds can take up to ten working days depending on the issuing bank.

title: High-value refund approval
text: Any refund above 50,000 rupees requires approval from a refund supervisor before it is issued.

title: Chargeback window
text: Customers may raise a chargeback with their card issuer within 120 days of the transaction date.

title: Cash on delivery
text: Cash-on-delivery orders are refunded to a bank account or wallet chosen by the customer, never in cash.

title: Foreign currency charges
text: Refunds of foreign-currency transactions are made in the original currency; exchange-rate differences are not compensated.

title: Gift cards
text: Gift cards and store credit are non-refundable and cannot be exchanged for cash.
